invariants: The canonical acp profile resolves the actual app provider and gates transport activation on accepted startup; help/usage errors do not bind protocol input or publish readiness.

ACP SDK 1.4.0 NDJSON framing retains split UTF-8, ECMAScript whitespace, final unterminated line, strict JSON parsing, typed ids and protocol error envelopes; malformed response-shaped input never causes response loops.
Registered request parameters follow the pinned generated SDK schema, including default-on-error, skipped invalid array items, stripped unknown fields and exact formatted invalid-parameter data.

Batch requests remain concurrent, replies correlate exact ids and are emitted together after required handlers settle; synchronous responders and delayed responders retain observed completion ordering.

Incoming protocol cancellation targets the exact typed id and current registration. Outgoing cancellation sends one cancel notification while retaining the response until the peer settles or the connection closes.

The actual protocol owns stdout and reversible input listeners; EOF, write failure and plugin unload prevent late writes and quiesce owned Session admission, Agent work, committed output and persistence.

Real canonical parent/child process journeys exercise initialization, new/config/prompt/cancel/list/resume/close, durable new-process recovery, malformed requests and EOF; actual extracted Portable repeats necessary launch behavior.
open_questions: MCP, one-shot permissions and complete subagent consumers remain A4; unsupported capability advertisement must remain truthful until their providers and consumers are accepted.
identity: SDK JSON-RPC typed null/string/finite-number ids; exact incoming registration; canonical app readiness and bridge-owned Agent/Session identities.
ownership: The app owns detachable Win7-compatible input adaptation and EOF binding; ACP owns ordered protocol writes, correlation and quiescence; caller-owned process handles are never closed by plugin disposal.
ordering: Accept command, publish readiness, activate transport, validate before domain side effects, admit and settle the owned prompt, drain output before result, revoke transport and cancel/drain on close.
errors: Pinned parse/invalid-request/method-not-found/invalid-params/internal envelopes; business errors are typed explicitly rather than treating every provider ValueError as invalid user input.
cancellation: Request cancellation is distinct from Session cancel; duplicate request ids cannot let an old finisher erase the new registration; EOF and unload settle all owned bridge effects.
adaptation: Python 3.8 stdlib framing and pinned SDK schema interpretation, Win7-compatible detachable pipe polling. Canonical boot dispatches reversible app/stopping before parallel fiber teardown; ACP revokes and drains its Agents and pending projection checkpoint writes while storage providers remain alive. This explicit Python scheduling adaptation is not an upstream bug exception.
